description: Check waitlist entries for an event type or get the status of a specific entry. Use this to report on an invitee's waitlist position or to see who is waiting. Filter by status (waiting, promoted, expired, cancelled).

entry_id.description: Specific waitlist entry ID to look up. If provided, returns just that entry.

event_type_id.description: ID of the event type to check waitlist for. Optional if entry_id is provided.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return (default: 10, max: 100)

status.description: Filter by waitlist entry status. Defaults to all statuses.

name: check_waitlist
